description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceCompleted" name="Successful service and next service time entered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CarArrived" name="Car arrives for service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_ServiceRecord" name="Service visit recorded"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Payment" name="Payment made via app"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Reminder" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Fine" name="Fine for missed service"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police Reminder App" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CarOwner" name="Car Owner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ServiceFacility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_ServiceFacility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CarArrives" name="Car brought in" sourceRef="Participant_CarOwner" targetRef="StartEvent_CarArrives"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Payment" name="Pay via app" sourceRef="Participant_CarOwner" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_StatusUpdate" name="Status update email" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ServiceRecord" name="Service record" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRecord" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_ServiceRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_NextServiceTime" name="Successful service" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Reminder" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Fine" name="Fine" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="Participant_CarOwner"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police Reminder App" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed successfully">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceCompleted" messageRef="Msg_ServiceCompleted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_ServiceNecessary" name="Service becomes necessary">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceNecessary"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check if car is still registered"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify car owner"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_VisitOrFine" name="Service visit or 30 days elapsed?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_ServiceRecorded" name="Service visit recorded">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceRecorded" messageRef="Msg_ServiceRecord"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_30Days" name="30 days after reminder">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine to car owner"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_VisitRecorded" name="Service visit done"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="No reminder: car not registered"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ServiceCompleted" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_ServiceNecessary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P2" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_ServiceNecessary" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P3" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P4" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P5" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P6" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_VisitOrFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P7" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitOrFine" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_ServiceRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P8" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitOrFine" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P9" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_ServiceRecorded" targetRef="End_VisitRecorded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_30Days" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_P11" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ServiceFacility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CarArrives" name="Car arrives at facility">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarArrives" messageRef="Msg_CarArrived"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterProblems" name="Mechanic enters car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendServiceRecord" name="Send service visit record to app"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WaitMerge" name="Waiting for repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Repair" name="Perform repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatusUpdate" name="Send status update via email"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairDone" name="Repair done?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSuccess" name="Mechanic enters successful repair and issues Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Payment" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Msg_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Mechanic enters time of next service"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceDone" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F1" sourceRef="StartEvent_CarArrives" targetRef="Task_EnterProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F2" sourceRef="Task_EnterProblems" targetRef="Task_SendServiceRecord"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F3" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRecord" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitMerge" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F5" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F6" sourceRef="Task_SendStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F7" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Gateway_WaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F8" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_EnterSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F9" sourceRef="Task_EnterSuccess" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Payment" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F11" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
